At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Your impact

At Jacobs, we don’t settle – always looking beyond to raise the bar and deliver with excellence. We apply our expertise and knowledge as we look into the future with great optimism and focus. We don’t settle until we give our best and know that we’re making a difference.

Our mission is to drive excellence across a diverse range of industries through our expertise in manufacturing, material handling, and facility planning/design. We combine historical insights with cutting-edge strategies to optimize processes, enhance capacity, and streamline operations. Leveraging historical databases and benchmark information, we provide data-driven solutions.

As an Industrial Engineer, you will provide technical and application support for the Electronics Advanced Facilities team (US location flexible - remote role). Each day, you will leverage your industry expertise to lead project teams of industrial engineering professionals to design and support state-of-the-art semiconductor facilities. Your main responsibility will be to support the development of the base build factory design and coordinate the requirements with clients, subcontractors, project management, and Jacobs’ disciplines. This includes validating utility planning and optimizing equipment layouts while considering all aspects of a fully operational facility.

Your role keeps our company connected and we’ll support you with what you need to be successful. Bring your creativity, ambitious spirit and extreme attention to detail, and we’ll help you grow, pursue and fulfill what drives you – so we can deliver extraordinary solutions for a better tomorrow, together.

Job Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Industrial, Mechanical, or Chemical Engineering
Must have a Professional Engineer License in Industrial and Systems, Mechanical, or Chemical Engineering
Must be able to obtain Professional Engineer License in OR, ID, and NY at start of employment
Minimum of 10 years of industry experience in semiconductor fab design, manufacturing, or closely related field
Ability to travel globally 5% to 15% of the time
Effective verbal and written communication skills
Data analysis experience using MS Excel, Power BI, or similar tools
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills





Here's what you'll need

Ideally, you’ll also have:

Familiarity with equipment specifications written in CSI Master format
Experience using database tools
Experience with Automated Material Handling Systems (AMHSs)
Expertise in semiconductor manufacturing tools used for logic chips, memory, and advanced packaging
Experience managing technical teams
Ability to collaborate and work effectively in a variety of teams, including multi-disciplinary teams

Our health and welfare benefits are designed to invest in you, and in the things you care about. Your health. Your well-being. Your security. Your future. Employees have access to medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance, a 401(k) plan, and the ability to purchase company stock at a discount. Eligible employees may also enroll in a deferred compensation plan or the Executive Deferral Plan. Jacobs has an unlimited U.S. Personalized Paid Time Off (PPTO) policy for full-time salaried/exempt employees, seven paid holidays, and caregiver leave. And certain roles may be eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases, performance discretionary bonus, and stock.

The base salary range for this position is $123,600.00 to $216,400.00. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.







All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. Job posted on September 09, 2024. This position will be open for at least 3 days.
